extracted.intended_audience: research and healthcare professionals (people reading and appraising clinical research)
extracted.subtask_description: Guiding users to appraise published research using CASP checklists and brief online training so they can judge trustworthiness, relevance, results, and applicability of studies across multiple study designs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assess trustworthiness, relevance and results
rubrics_metrics.description: Critical appraisal skills enable you to systematically assess the trustworthiness, relevance and results of published papers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When reading a paper, explicitly consider whether the study is trustworthy (methodologically sound), whether the results are relevant to your question or population, and what the results actually show (size, precision, consistency). Use a structured approach rather than ad-hoc judgement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use CASP checklists when reading research
rubrics_metrics.description: Our free critical appraisal checklists are designed to be used when reading research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply a CASP checklist as a practical tool while reading a paper to guide appraisal, rather than relying on memory. The checklists provide question prompts and structure for evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select checklist appropriate to study design
rubrics_metrics.description: Critical appraisal tools can help when reviewing Systematic Reviews, Randomised Controlled Trials, Cohort Studies, Case Control Studies, Economic Evaluations, Diagnostic Studies, Qualitative studies, Cross-Sectional Studies and more!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify the study design first, then use the corresponding CASP checklist tailored to that design so that design-specific biases and validity issues are considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluate claimed intervention effectiveness and potential harms/resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Many interventions are given with the best of intentions but have later been found to be ineffective with the potential for harm and wasted resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In appraising interventions, assess not only effectiveness but also safety and resource implications. Question whether results justify adoption and consider possible harms and opportunity costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adopt non-hierarchical, multidisciplinary, problem-based appraisal approaches
rubrics_metrics.description: The philosophy of CASP has always been about sharing knowledge and understanding, working in ways that are non-hierarchical, multidisciplinary and using problem-based approaches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use collaborative, problem-focused appraisal methods that draw on multiple perspectives and make the process accessible and applicable to day-to-day practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use short online modules and training to build appraisal confidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Short, online learning modules increase confidence when reading research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complement checklist use with brief, focused training (self-study modules or subscription service) to learn how to apply appraisal tools correctly and consistently.
